messages:
Priya (CS): Quick heads-up — several onboarding tenants (EU/US) reported failed embeddings ingestion and elevated 5xx rates between 02:12–02:28 UTC this morning. Eng triage in progress. We'll need a short customer-safe status note and an offer for enablement/office hours. @Samir can you paste current triage notes? :rotating_light:
Samir (Eng): On it. Root cause looks like a cascading KV-store timeout triggered by a config roll last night. Nora is rolling back the config and rehydrating shards. ETA ~20m. Short log: ```ERROR kv-client shard-7: rpc timeout 5000ms -> retries exhausted```
Nora (SRE): Rollback started: rollback-id=rc-2026-03-22-02. Rolling rehydration on shard-6/7. After rollback we expect steady-state within ~15m and no data loss expected. Monitoring dashboard: https://internal.ops/redwood/alerts/ingest-embeds-4600
Liam (AM): I can send a tailored note to affected renewals and high-touch trials offering 2 weeks of credits + a 1:1 enablement session. Need recommended wording and confirmation that no customer data was exfiltrated.
Priya (CS): Draft note (safe): 'We're investigating an intermittent ingestion error affecting embeddings creation for some tenants. Engineering has identified the source and applied mitigation; we expect full recovery shortly. No customer data exposure. We're scheduling live troubleshooting and offering account credits. We'll follow up with an RCA.' Thoughts?
Samir (Eng): LGTM. Please add a link to self-serve retry guidance and a short repro for customers to validate: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"input":"test"}'``` and confirm a `200` response.
Priya (CS): Agree. Liam please queue the top 12 impacted accounts and send the note. Also capture feedback: ask for a sample failing payload and whether they used batch or streaming ingestion.
Liam (AM): Queued and sending now. I'll ping here with replies. Scheduling office hours 2x this week (Wed/Fri PST) — will invite all impacted tenants. :calendar:
OpsBot: Incident rollback complete. All ingestion pipelines reporting normal. Metric window: 02:41–02:44 UTC. Incident ID: INC-4600. RCA drafting started — expected public RCA within 48h.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. Action items: 1) Liam send comms + credits offer 2) Samir/Nora finalize RCA draft 3) CS capture feedback payloads in tracker https://docs.internal/cs/incident-4600-feedback 4) Schedule office hours. I'll follow up on thread when we have customer replies.
